title: Stablecoin Proliferation is a Treasury Policy Problem
summary:
Accepting many stablecoins and deciding what reaches the balance sheet are separate decisions. Rhino.fi founder Will Harborne on settlement policy.
The post Stablecoin Proliferation is a Treasury Policy Problem appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: The proliferation of stablecoins has become a significant treasury policy challenge for organizations. According to Rhino.fi founder Will Harborne, businesses must carefully distinguish between accepting multiple stablecoins and deciding which assets ultimately reach their balance sheets. Establishing a clear settlement policy is crucial for navigating this complex financial landscape effectively.

Rhino.fi நிறுவனத்தின் நிறுவனர் Will Harborne இன் கூற்றுப்படி, பல ஸ்டேபிள்காயின்களை ஏற்றுக்கொள்வதற்கும், எந்த சொத்துகள் இறுதியில் தங்கள் இருப்புநிலைக் குறிப்பை எட்டுகின்றன என்பதைத் தீர்மானிப்பதற்கும் வணிகங்கள் கவனமாகப் பிரித்தறிய வேண்டும். இந்த சிக்கலான நிதி நிலப்பரப்பை திறம்பட வழிநடத்த தெளிவான தீர்வு கொள்கையை நிறுவுவது முக்கியமானது.

title: Navar Capital Launches New Investment Platform for Accredited Investors  * link below in the comments  #Investment #WealthManagement #FinancialIT
summary:
Navar Capital, LLC today announced the launch of its investment management platform, powered by its proprietary QRI™ (Quant-Real-Intelligence) framework, and the introduction of the Navar Capital Income Fund, LP and Navar Capital Growth Fund, LP available exclusively to verified accredited investors under SEC Rule 506(c).
Founded by technology entrepreneur and investor Rajesh Navar, Navar Capital combines artificial intelligence, quantitative modeling, technical and fundamental research, and disciplined risk management to identify high-growth and income-generating investment opportunities. The firm integrates advanced data analytics with real-world market insight to support active portfolio management and long-term investment decision-making.
“Successful investing requires disciplined analysis, sound judgment, and experience," said Rajesh Navar, Founder and CEO of Navar Capital. “Our unique approach combines quantitative research with decades of investing experience to identify compelling opportunities while maintaining a disciplined focus on risk management, transparency, and long-term value creation.”
Rajesh brings more than 35 years of experience spanning technology, investing, and entrepreneurship. After helping build eBay before its 1998 IPO, he founded LiveDeal.com, which merged with YP.com and became a publicly traded Nasdaq company. An early artificial intelligence pioneer whose research was published by IEEE, he has invested in more than 20 technology startups and successfully navigated multiple market cycles.
The Navar Capital Income Fund is designed for investors seeking current income together with long-term capital appreciation through a disciplined covered-call and dividend-focused strategy. The Navar Capital Growth Fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio. As a matter of investment policy, both Funds operate on a non-margin basis and do not utilize leverage.
Since implementing its QRI™ framework in 2024, the Navar Capital Growth Fund has generated cumulative returns exceeding 120%, equivalent to an annualized net return of approximately 34%. This includes a 14.80% year-to-date net return through August 31, 2026. Since its inception in May 2026, the Navar Capital Income Fund has declared cumulative cash distributions equal to 7.39% of invested capital through August 31, 2026, representing an annualized distribution rate of approximately 22.18%. Performance results for 2024 and 2025 have been audited, while all 2026 performance and distribution figures are unaudited. All figures are presented net of applicable fees and expenses.
Built on the principles of performance, trust, and transparency, Navar Capital is supported by independent institutional service providers for fund administration, custody, and auditing. Investors also benefit from secure online reporting, daily Net Asset Value (NAV) updates, and a General Partner that maintains a significant personal capital commitment alongside investors.
NoYesInvestment11 Sep, 2026
content: Navar Capital has launched a new investment management platform and two funds exclusively for accredited investors, founded by technology entrepreneur Rajesh Navar. The firm utilizes its proprietary QRI framework, combining artificial intelligence and quantitative modeling for risk-managed portfolio strategies. The growth fund has reported strong cumulative returns since its 2024 implementation, while the income fund offers dividend-focused strategies, both operating entirely on a non-margin basis without leverage.
